title: High-Value Vehicles and the Loading on the Host's Share
content:
A vehicle the marketplace values highly carries a loading on the host's share of an accepted loss under the Keyturn Host Protection Plan. The marketplace's high-value share mark is 40000.

- Where the marketplace's valuation of the vehicle reaches the marketplace's high-value share mark and the vehicle's listing sits in a value class above the marketplace's standard class, the marketplace's high-value loading of 1.16 is applied to the share.
- Where that valuation reaches the mark and the listing sits in the standard class or below it, the marketplace's standard-value loading of 1.08 is applied.
- Where the valuation does not reach the mark, no loading is applied.

### The classes on either side of the standard class

A listing standing in the Keyturn Premium Class Listing, the Keyturn Luxury Class Listing or the Keyturn Exotic Class Listing sits above the standard class. A listing standing in the Keyturn Standard Class Listing, the Keyturn Economy Class Listing or the Keyturn Commercial Van Class Listing sits in the standard class or below it.

### Worked readings (hypothetical figures, on a share of 2000 before this step)

| Marketplace valuation | Value class of the listing | Share becomes |
|---|---|---|
| 52000 | Keyturn Luxury Class Listing | 2320.00 |
| 52000 | Keyturn Standard Class Listing | 2160.00 |
| 39000 | any | 2000.00 |

A valuation of exactly 40000 reaches the mark; one of 39999 does not, and no loading is applied whatever the class.

### Source of the readings

The marketplace's valuation of the vehicle and the value class it sits in are read from the Keyturn Vehicle Listing standing for that vehicle.
